definition: the day or evening before an event
description: An apple orchard at dusk under a purple evening sky. A young woman in a cream jumper and green skirt stands on a wooden stepladder, hanging a string of round light bulbs on a branch, while a young man in a blue shirt below holds up the rest of the glowing string and smiles up at her. A long table is already laid with a white cloth, a glass jug and glasses, with benches on both sides, but no guests have arrived yet. Crates of plants stand ready in the grass.

taps.phrase: to string lights along a branch
